scientific_limitations: Only independent identically distributed Bernoulli variables with common p in [0,1/3], normalized nonnegative weights, at most five nonzero weights, and inclusive threshold at the mean. The sharp light-stake gap is uniform across the stated class and is approached but not attained. The unrestricted number-of-weights conjecture remains open.
title: A sharp five-weight gap for Bernoulli mean crossings
